Senior Job Captain
SLCE Architects is seeking a highly motivated Senior Job Captain to join our Los Angeles office. This role is ideal for an experienced architectural professional with strong technical expertise, advanced Revit skills, and demonstrated experience applying the California Building Code (CBC) on complex multifamily, mixed-use, and commercial projects.
The successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating projects through all phases of design, permitting, and construction documentation. This position requires substantial experience with cast-in-place reinforced concrete buildings and the ability to produce and coordinate high-quality construction documents for California jurisdictions.
Required: Significant experience applying the California Building Code (CBC) and coordinating permit approvals with California jurisdictions.
Responsibilities
Project Coordination
Construction Documents & Technical Production
Technical Development
Construction Administration
Design Support
Qualifications
Ideal Candidate
Work Arrangement
This is a full-time, in-office position based in our Santa Monica office. Regular in-person attendance is an essential requirement and critical to effective collaboration, mentorship, project coordination, and project delivery.
SLCE does not offer this position as a permanent remote or hybrid role. Limited temporary remote work accommodations may be considered on a case-by-case basis and are subject to management approval.
About SLCE Architects
SLCE Architects is a multidisciplinary architectural practice with more than 85 years of experience and a portfolio of over 3,500 projects worldwide. The firm provides design and technical services across a broad range of project types, including residential, mixed-use, commercial, affordable housing, senior living, and institutional developments.
Known for its technical expertise, collaborative approach, and commitment to quality, SLCE partners with developers, institutions, and nonprofit organizations to deliver successful projects that positively impact the communities they serve.
About Our Los Angeles Office
SLCE's Los Angeles office, located in Santa Monica, represents an exciting expansion of the firm's long-standing architectural practice beyond New York City.
As one of SLCE's newest offices, we are building a team of talented professionals who are eager to contribute not only to exceptional project work, but also to the growth of a strong studio culture and collaborative office community. This is a unique opportunity to join an office during an important stage of its development and help shape its future.
We are seeking individuals who thrive in a team-oriented environment, enjoy working closely with colleagues, and are excited about helping build a dynamic and engaging workplace. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on projects while contributing to the culture, standards, and identity of our growing Los Angeles office.
For professionals looking to be part of an entrepreneurial, expanding team backed by the resources, reputation, and experience of an established architectural practice, this role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the next chapter of SLCE's growth.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary Range: $100,000 - $125,000
SLCE offers a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment that supports career growth.
To Apply
Please submit your resume, portfolio, and work samples demonstrating construction documentation, California code expertise, permit coordination experience, and project leadership responsibilities. Preferred work samples should include multifamily, mixed-use, commercial, institutional, or senior living projects illustrating code analysis, consultant coordination, and cast-in-place reinforced concrete construction experience.
